title: Chris the Hacker and Tom the Fag - Sep 2009 - 9/10 - "Same Old Lies"
description:
Same old lies, though the lie in question wasn't revealed to us until years later, in early 2012.  Chris's claim that prank callers "manipulate" the audio in some way so that they can talk, and it comes out in Chris's voice, rather like "Futurama", except that technology does not exist; the closest thing we have would be voice morphers which wouldn't sound anything like Chris.

It was speculated he used this excuse to try to backtrack from unflattering comments made about policemen and soldiers in the midst of a NWO rant, but we see here he'd been using it much earlier.
